conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need help disputing some charges. I have issues on four different cards — my personal Gold Rewards card, my Crypto-Cash Back card, my EcoCard, and my Business Gold Rewards card. There’s been fraud and other problems on all of them.

{
  "message": "Thanks — I can help. Because this involves accessing and (potentially) filing disputes on your accounts, I need to verify your identity first. Please provide any TWO of the following exactly as they appear on your Rho-Bank account: 1) date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), 2) email on the account, 3) phone number on the account, or 4) mailing address on file. After verification I can look up accounts, file disputes, and (if you want) order replacement cards.

Before we verify, a few quick questions so I know what you want done and what information I’ll need once we’re verified:
- Do you want me to file disputes on your behalf for all four cards now (Personal Gold Rewards, Crypto‑Cash Back, EcoCard, Business Gold Rewards)? Or do you want guidance so you can file them yourself?

For each disputed charge please be ready to give (per charge):
- Card name and last 4 digits
- Transaction date (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Transaction amount
- Merchant name or description
- Was this an in‑store (card present) or online/phone (card not present) charge?
- Do you still have the physical card in your possession? (yes/no)
- Do you believe your PIN was compromised? (answer: yes_shared, yes_observed, no, or unknown)
- Have you already contacted the merchant about this charge? (yes/no)
- Have you filed a police report? (yes/no) — we recommend filing for fraud over $500
- Are you willing to provide a written statement describing what happened? (If yes, you can agree to use this chat as your written statement)

Notes you may find helpful before we proceed:
- Debit disputes have strict timing rules (reporting quickly can limit your liability). If any disputed charge is on a debit card, please tell me right away.
- Credit card provisional credit eligibility requires certain criteria (e.g., account open ≥60 days and dispute amount ≥$25). Gold and Business Gold are premium tier (higher provisional limits); EcoCard and Crypto‑Cash Back are entry tier (lower provisional limits).
- If you suspect fraud on a card, we can also order a replacement card and/or freeze the card — I’ll confirm next steps after verification.

If you prefer to speak to a human instead of doing identity verification here, say so and I’ll transfer you. Otherwise, please provide two of the verification fields now so I can proceed."
